rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing its protocol of 23 March 2004 on the election results (108,064,281 voters on the lists; 69,581,761 took part, 64.39 percent; Putin Vladimir Vladimirovich 49,565,238 votes, 71.31 percent), the CEC declares the presidential election valid and deems Putin Vladimir Vladimirovich elected President of the Russian Federation, and orders publication in Rossiyskaya Gazeta, Parlamentskaya Gazeta and the CEC Vestnik; signed A. Veshnyakov (Chairman) and O. Zastrozhnaya (Secretary), 23 March 2004, No. 99/799-4.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The attached data give votes per registered candidate: Glazyev 2,850,063 (4.10%), Malyshkin 1,405,315 (2.02%), Mironov 524,324 (0.75%), Putin 49,565,238 (71.31%), Khakamada 2,671,313 (3.84%), Kharitonov 9,513,313 (13.69%); against all 2,396,219 (3.45%).
